Prattville Tuesday Loop

Prattville, AL · Road

No-drop

Prattville Tuesday Loop is a road group ride in Prattville, AL. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Prattville Medical Park. About 19 miles, c 13–15, B 16–18, A 19–21 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 19–21 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Prattville Tuesday Loop group ride

An 18 to 19 mile evening loop around Prattville with rotating leaders. C and B groups are no-drop and regroup at most turns. The A group is a drop ride. Bring front and rear lights.
